title: Iconic Character Introduction
prompt: Describe an iconic video game character and explain why they are widely recognized.
hint: Think about characters that are famous and easily recognized by many people.
sample: Super Mario is an iconic character because he is widely known and recognized around the world.

ja.prompt: 有名で広く知られているゲームのキャラクターについて説明してください。
ja.hint: 多くの人に知られている有名なキャラクターを考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: スーパーマリオは世界中で広く知られている象徴的なキャラクターです。

local.hint: Think about characters that are famous and easily recognized by many people.
local.sample: Super Mario is an iconic character because he is widely known and recognized around the world.

zh.prompt: 描述一個標誌性的電子遊戲角色，並解釋為什麼他們廣為人知。
zh.hint: 想想那些著名且被許多人認識的角色。
zh.sample: 超級瑪利歐是一個標誌性角色，因為他在全世界都廣為人知。

en.prompt: Describe an iconic video game character and explain why they are widely recognized.
en.hint: Think about characters that are famous and easily recognized by many people.
en.sample: Super Mario is an iconic character because he is widely known and recognized around the world.

title: Video Game History Quiz
prompt: Which game did the character Mario first appear in? Choose from: A) The Legend of Zelda, B) Donkey Kong, C) Pokemon.
hint: Mario is a famous character but his first appearance was not in The Legend of Zelda or Pokemon.
sample: The correct answer is B) Donkey Kong.

ja.prompt: マリオが最初に登場したゲームはどれですか？A) ゼルダの伝説、B) ドンキーコング、C) ポケモンから選んでください。
ja.hint: マリオは有名なキャラクターですが、最初の登場はゼルダの伝説やポケモンではありません。
ja.sample: 正解はB) ドンキーコングです。

local.hint: Mario is a famous character but his first appearance was not in The Legend of Zelda or Pokemon.
local.sample: The correct answer is B) Donkey Kong.

zh.prompt: 瑪利歐這個角色最初出現在哪款遊戲？請從以下選擇：A）薩爾達傳說，B）大金剛，C）寶可夢。
zh.hint: 瑪利歐是著名角色，但他最初並非出現在薩爾達傳說或寶可夢中。

en.hint: Mario is a famous character but his first appearance was not in The Legend of Zelda or Pokemon.
en.sample: The correct answer is B) Donkey Kong.

title: Meaning of 'A Flood of'
prompt: Explain the meaning of the phrase 'a flood of' as used in the context of video games.
hint: It refers to a large number of something happening in a short time.
sample: 'A flood of games' means many games were released in a short period.

ja.prompt: 「a flood of」という表現の意味を説明してください。
ja.hint: 短い期間に多くのものが起こることを指します。
ja.sample: 「a flood of games」は短期間に多くのゲームが発売されたことを意味します。

local.prompt: Explain the meaning of the phrase 'a flood of' as used in the context of video games.
local.hint: It refers to a large number of something happening in a short time.

zh.prompt: 解釋短語「a flood of」在電子遊戲語境中的意思。
zh.hint: 指的是在短時間內大量的某物發生。
zh.sample: 「a flood of games」表示在短時間內發行了許多遊戲。

en.prompt: Explain the meaning of the phrase 'a flood of' as used in the context of video games.
en.hint: It refers to a large number of something happening in a short time.
en.sample: 'A flood of games' means many games were released in a short period.

title: Understanding 'Holds Up'
prompt: What does the phrase 'holds up' mean when talking about old video games?
hint: It means the quality or standard has not decreased over time.
sample: Super Mario 'holds up' because it is still fun to play even after many years.

ja.prompt: 古いゲームについて「holds up」という表現は何を意味しますか？
ja.hint: 時間が経っても品質や基準が落ちていないことを意味します。
ja.sample: スーパーマリオは何年経っても楽しく遊べるので「holds up」と言えます。

local.hint: It means the quality or standard has not decreased over time.

zh.prompt: 談論老遊戲時，「holds up」這個短語是什麼意思？
zh.hint: 表示品質或標準隨時間沒有下降。
zh.sample: 超級瑪利歐「holds up」，因為多年後仍然很好玩。

en.prompt: What does the phrase 'holds up' mean when talking about old video games?
en.hint: It means the quality or standard has not decreased over time.
en.sample: Super Mario 'holds up' because it is still fun to play even after many years.

title: Vocabulary Recap from the Program
prompt: Define the following vocabulary from the program: iconic, a flood of, sighted, boom, unplayable, holds up.
hint: Use simple explanations for each word based on the program's context.
sample: Iconic means famous and easily recognized; a flood of means a large amount in a short time; sighted means referenced; boom means a sudden growth; unplayable means cannot be played; holds up means quality remains good.
